_note: Waterway settings. 'onlyRequired': true = only the waterways listed in 'required' are on the tests (asked every time they are in a district, and must be correct). 'local': extra accepted names. 'drop': waterways to leave off. 'rename': replace the official display name. 'pins': fixed pin position [lat, lng] for a waterway (used in every district it is in).
